gui.botania_runic_ritualization.apotheca: Place a seed and surround with filled pedestals.
tooltip.botania_runic_ritualization.runi: A Runic Altar refined for batch crafting, drawing from nearby Pedestals of Living Rock.
tooltip.botania_runic_ritualization.peta: A Petal Apothecary refined for batch crafting, drawing from nearby Pedestals of Living Rock.
tooltip.botania_runic_ritualization.bota: A Botanical Brewery refined for batch crafting, drawing from nearby Pedestals of Living Rock.
tooltip.botania_runic_ritualization.pede: Holds ingredients for nearby ritual altars to draw upon.
botania_runic_ritualization.page.runic_a: The $(item)Runic Altar Dais$(0) is a $(l:basics/rune_altar)$(item)Runic Altar$(0)$(/l) refined for batch crafting. Place $(l:devices/pedestal_of_living_rock)$(item)Pedestals of Living Rock$(0)$(/l) nearby and fill them with ingredients; the dais will draw from them to craft in batches, consuming mana from its internal pool.$(p)Select a recipe from the GUI, provide mana via a $(thing)Mana Spreader$(0) or $(thing)Spark$(0), and the dais will craft continuously as long as ingredients remain.
botania_runic_ritualization.page.petal_a: The $(item)Petal Apothecary Everflowing$(0) is a $(l:basics/apothecary)$(item)Petal Apothecary$(0)$(/l) refined for batch crafting. Place $(l:devices/pedestal_of_living_rock)$(item)Pedestals of Living Rock$(0)$(/l) nearby and fill them with petals and reagents; the apothecary will draw from them to craft in batches.$(p)Provide a seed as the reagent and mana from a $(thing)Mana Spreader$(0) or $(thing)Spark$(0), and it will craft continuously as long as ingredients remain.
botania_runic_ritualization.page.botanic: The $(item)Botanical Brewery Aludel$(0) is a $(l:basics/brewery)$(item)Botanical Brewery$(0)$(/l) refined for batch crafting. Place $(l:devices/pedestal_of_living_rock)$(item)Pedestals of Living Rock$(0)$(/l) nearby and fill them with ingredients; the aludel will draw from them to brew in batches.$(p)Provide a vial or flask and mana from a $(thing)Mana Spreader$(0) or $(thing)Spark$(0), and it will brew continuously as long as ingredients remain.
botania_runic_ritualization.page.pedesta: The $(item)Pedestal of Living Rock$(0) is a simple platform that holds a single item. When placed near a $(l:devices/runic_altar_dais)$(item)Runic Altar Dais$(0)$(/l), $(l:devices/petal_apothecary_everflowing)$(item)Petal Apothecary Everflowing$(0)$(/l), or $(l:devices/botanical_brewery_aludel)$(item)Botanical Brewery Aludel$(0)$(/l), the altar will draw the pedestal's contents as ingredients for batch crafting.
